metadata.llm_reason: Candidate combines two distinct semantic capabilities: (1) quantile threshold inspection (already covered by peer 7ea98ae1), and (2) scale cloning/copying (a state mutation operation distinct from read-only inspection). The cloning aspect should merge into the value lookup skill as a complementary operation within scale instance management, while the quantiles inspection is redundant with the existing peer. The candidate conflates inspection (read-only) with mutation (copy), which violates separation of concerns.
